gen-gf-lumanosimo-fs-fira-sans: Loose pen-drawn charm up top, then a tidy turn. Lumanosimo wanders across its open gaps, while Fira Sans, a plain sans with tall lowercase, would swamp it if the heading shrank.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-fs-public-sans: Lumanosimo's wiry, uniform strokes look written by hand with a pen. Public Sans follows with a hefty, broad-countered lowercase that keeps a long page sturdy and easy to settle into.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-fs-supreme: Casual and graceful, Lumanosimo draws every line like bent wire. Supreme, a sans-serif, lays a dense, crisp band of open letters beneath it, so the loose hand and the firm text push against each other.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-general-sans: General Sans fills its lines with tall lowercase and smooth, unobstructed curves, drawn with steady pressure throughout. Lumanosimo's looser, lower, hand-drawn heading sits above it comfortably.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-gf-bhutuka-expanded-on: BhuTuka Expanded One brings curvy, literary letters whose thin joins hold as firm as the stems. Lumanosimo's pen-drawn heading sits above, and the text beneath slows the eye to a leisurely walk.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-gf-hepta-slab: Lumanosimo writes in a loose, wire-thin hand, while Hepta Slab below stretches its serif words out with open counters and no thick-thin shifts. Shrink that heading and the slab outweighs it.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-gf-kiwi-maru: Traditional in spirit, Kiwi Maru has generous spacing and round, constant-walled o shapes. Lumanosimo's casual, graceful pen lines sit lightly over this serif, so the page feels editorial but unstiff.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-gf-orbit: Lumanosimo draws everything in one wiry, pen-on-paper line, loose and drawn-out across its gaps. Orbit, a sans-serif, floats each rope-like character apart, curves stopping short instead of closing.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-gf-padyakke-expanded-o: Padyakke Expanded One spreads wide, literary letters like knots on a slack rope. Its pitcher-mouthed c shapes and unswelling bowls give this text serif a slow, authoritative stance beside Lumanosimo's casual hand.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-gf-science-gothic: Approachable on both sides, yet different in hand. Lumanosimo is best at casual, graceful pen lines, whereas Science Gothic, a sans-serif, spaces its stroke ends far apart and lets you read letter by letter.
